mira: Quick sync: I'm proposing a compact rollout metadata variant to reduce pin churn and enable tenant-scoped soft locks. fields: release_stamp, lock_token, lock_scope (tenant|global), ttl_secs (optional). thoughts?
kai: Tenant default for lock_scope please. we had a global pin accidentally last quarter and it took ages to debug.
jules: If ttl_secs is optional we must have a reconciler that garbage-collects stale locks. otherwise legacy pins could block forever. recommend default soft-ttl for legacy pins = 30d.
mira: Agreed on reconciler. Migration plan idea: read-only compatibility: treat existing `pin` as release_stamp; only create new meta records on write or admin-triggered bulk migrate. avoids huge write bursts.
ops-bot: schema-lint: sampled prod shows ~0.6% pins with non-string values. those need manual remediation before auto-synth.
kai: Token design: server-signed opaque token (random + hmac(model|tenant|version)) so clients can't spoof. make tokens 64 chars.
jules: Runtime API: cas_acquire(model_id, tenant_id, expected_stamp, client_token_opt, ttl) -> success|failure + current_stamp + server_token + expires_at. Also add force_release(admin) with audit log.
mira: Action items: 1) I'll open a doc PR with migration phases and reconciler SLOs. 2) @kai to draft token signing + validation. 3) @jules to add server-side permissive validation with a 14-day warning window before hard reject.
ops-bot: note: deploy-bot will emit warnings for missing schema_version for 2 weeks post-rollout.
mira: thanks all, i'll start the PR and include samples of the shim transform for legacy pins. :thumbsup:
